extracted.intended_audience: general readers and movie-goers seeking critic reviews and aggregated scores
extracted.subtask_description: A listing/aggregation page of film reviews from The A.V. Club on Metacritic showing per-title critic scores, Metascores, short review excerpts, and distribution statistics. Used for browsing recent reviews and quick qualitative/quantitative impressions of films.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metascore
rubrics_metrics.description: Numeric 'Metascore' value shown next to each title (e.g., '83' for Remarkably Bright Creatures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed as the aggregated Metascore column used to compare films at a glance; the page shows the Metascore alongside each review entry and provides sorting by Metascore.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critic Score (publication-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication-specific critic score displayed for The A.V. Club next to each title (e.g., 'Critic Score The A.V. Club 53').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the score assigned by this publication for the film; presented alongside the Metascore to indicate the outlet's assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critic Score Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentages of critic sentiment across reviews, shown as 'positive 5.6k (53%), mixed 3.7k (36%), negative 1.1k (11%)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an overall breakdown of how many critic reviews fall into positive/mixed/negative categories to convey consensus and spread.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avg. Critic Score
rubrics_metrics.description: An overall 'Avg. Critic Score' value shown in the page header (e.g., 'Avg. Critic Score 62').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents the average critic score for the publication's movies on the page; useful as a high-level summary of the outlet's scoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highest and Lowest Critic Scores (examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Displayed extremes for the publication such as 'Highest Critic Score 100 — Badlands' and 'Lowest Critic Score 0 — A Life Less Ordinary'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights the range of scores given by the publication and provides context for interpreting individual scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recency / Sorting options
rubrics_metrics.description: Organization cues like 'Recently Added' and sorting labels 'Metascore / Name (A-Z)' that determine which reviews are shown first or how they are ordered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls how the listing is presented (newest items first, alphabetical, or by score), affecting discoverability and the user's reading order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review excerpt / summary sentence
rubrics_metrics.description: A one-sentence excerpt per review summarizing the critic's qualitative judgment (e.g., 'While Remarkably Bright Creatures may repel those with little patience for stories of fate...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides quick qualitative context and rationale alongside numeric scores, including a byline (author) and a link to the full review for detail.
